entities.summary: Hanneke Smabers is a former field hockey midfielder from the Netherlands, who played 126 international matches for the Dutch national team, and scored 12 goals. She made her debut on 3 July 1993 against Germany (0-2), and was a member of the team that won the bronze medal at the 2000 Summer Olympics. Her younger sister, Minke, also played international hockey for the national team.
